title: Is a College Degree Even Worth the Money Anymore? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Is a $400K tuition bill really worth it for four years of partying? In today's episode, Jill and Mark break down how to get the most value out of your college degree, and when it might not be worth the price at all. Plus, caller Michael wants to know whether he can realistically afford the home renovation he's been eyeing.
